Name: Create the Telegram bot (BotFather), a Cloudflare account, and an Anthropic API key
Description: 20 minutes. Steps in bot/README.md. Hand the token, key, and your Telegram chat id to the co-founder through a secure channel.

Name: Decide repo visibility: public or private
Description: github.com/taiusheev/vela. Decide once; don't drift.

Name: Post the survey in three places today
Description: Own network, a Russian-speaking Telegram group, Taiwanese friends (ZH-TW). Materials: plan/materials/survey-*.md and recruitment-posts.md.

Name: Book 8 interviews from survey respondents who opted in
Description: Script: plan/materials/interview-script.md plus the wish/worry questions. 20–30 minutes each.

Name: Show your parent a mock of the morning arrival; write down her exact words
Description: Use design/wireframes/03-parent-surface.svg. Her words go into plan/decisions.md.

Name: Update survey intro and recruitment posts for the all-families framing
Description: Materials in plan/materials/.

Name: Prototype changes for phase 0
Description: Family content in the arrival; quiet notice to the child with nearby contacts; away mode by keyword; founder card only for AI flags.

Name: Landing page with waitlist and two price points
Description: The flame, the promise, two questions (where does your parent live, which messenger), $9.99 vs $14.99 shown alternately. Free hosting.

Name: Weekly review template and decisions log in the repo
Description: plan/weekly/ and plan/decisions.md.

Name: Interviews 9–16, each ending with the pilot offer
Description: $15 for the month, refundable, starts Monday. Take payment on the spot (Wise, Revolut, PayPal).

Name: 10 families confirmed with three generations where possible
Description: Eldest, organiser, one under-30 member. Collect parents' messengers, wake times, two nearby contacts each.

Name: Deploy the prototype; three-day test with the founder's own parent
Description: Needs the three accounts from week 1.

Name: Onboarding script: five minutes with the child, five with the parent, in Russian
Interview synthesis
Description: Top objections, reasons to say yes, price points named, wish/worry clustering.

Name: Onboard 10–15 families; do the parent call yourself for the first five
Daily 15-minute check on the loop
Description: Read every conversation; log every false quiet notice and every parent complaint.

Name: Write the weekly read by hand for each family on Sunday
Description: AI drafts, you edit; every edit is logged as a product lesson.

Name: Interview anyone who declined or dropped
Description: Their reasons matter more than the yeses.

Name: Daily metrics in the ops board
Description: Answer rate, latency, family-content days, quiet notices and whether true, opt-outs.

Name: Day-14 check-in with every family
Description: One question: If Vela stopped tomorrow, how would you feel? Record exact words.

Name: Ask each parent through the chat whether she likes receiving it
Description: «Нравится ли вам получать это по утрам?»

Name: Ask each paying family for two introductions
Phase-0 report
Description: The metrics, what the arrival must contain, what the weekly read must say, MVP scope cut to what was proven.

Name: Pitch deck v1 from phase-0 evidence
Description: Ten slides; outline in plan/execution-plan.md.

Name: Decision: build the MVP, or change one variable and rerun phase 0
Description: Kill signals: fewer than 4 families paying after 20 interviews; more than 30% of parents refusing; family-content days under 30% by week two.
